intent: Verify whether the Gorilla Heavy Duty GG 836-1A0 Adhesive and Glue catalogue item carries the claimed extra properties (adhesive type wood glue, color family Gray, adhesive type threadlocker), and answer NO with the checked SKU if the base product exists but the claim is absent.
success_criteria: Base product matching brand=Gorilla and model='GG 836-1A0' is located in product_variants with its record_path.
Its product_variant_properties are inspected for adhesive_type and color_family values.
If the base product exists but the claimed extra properties (adhesive type wood glue / color family Gray / adhesive type threadlocker) are not all present, answer contains <NO> and the checked SKU.
Answer cites the exact product record_path of the checked SKU.

args.stdin: SELECT v.product_sku, v.record_path, v.product_name, v.brand, v.series, v.model, p.property_key, p.property_value_text FROM product_variants v LEFT JOIN product_variant_properties p ON p.product_sku = v.product_sku WHERE v.brand = :brand AND v.model = :model ORDER BY v.product_sku, p.property_key;

agents_md_constraints.rule: When responding with reference - provide full path in the repo to the object.
When answering yes/no questions - include <YES> or <NO> tokens in the response. This is how the agent will know how to style the response.

answer_template.message: Checked base product {catalogue_rows.product_sku} ({catalogue_rows.product_name}, record {catalogue_rows.record_path}). The catalogue item does not carry the claimed extra properties (adhesive type 'wood glue' / color family 'Gray' / adhesive type 'threadlocker'); the support note's added catalogue claim is absent. <NO>
